contracts.label: Contracts
contracts.hint: Choose a real offer. Counter-offers and delivery details are optional.

people.label: People
people.hint: Choose your team. Routine schedules can stay with the assistant.

finance.label: Finance
finance.hint: Cash, profit and the lowest forecast are enough for the next decision.

segments.label: Segments
segments.hint: See the result first; open the report when you want the breakdown.

group.label: Group
group.hint: Choose a group job. Transfer prices and consolidated reports stay in details.

market.label: Market
market.hint: Explore market choices at your own pace. Rival reports are optional.

governance.label: Governance and insurance
governance.hint: Choose protection or resolve a real case. Routine filing can be delegated.

manufacturing.label: Line Planner
manufacturing.hint: Choose an order, then reserve a slot. Fine tuning stays in Advanced.

real_estate.label: Matchmaker
real_estate.hint: Choose a client and a place. Financing details are there when you need them.

media.label: Campaign Mixer
media.hint: Create the idea, then choose your mix. Routine delivery can be delegated.

hotel.label: Rate Board
hotel.hint: Choose your hotel direction. Daily rates and cleaning can stay with the assistant.

automotive.label: Auto Desk
automotive.hint: Choose a car or fleet direction. Maintenance can stay with the assistant.

energy.label: Energy Console
energy.hint: Choose a roof or charging site. Place panels on the roof; fine tuning is optional.

trade.label: International Trade
trade.hint: Choose a route. The assistant can prepare repeat documents.

trade_quote.label: Trade estimate
trade_quote.hint: Compare cost, margin and downside before signing. Details keep every term.

fundraising.label: Fundraising and partners
fundraising.hint: Choose an investor or review a real offer. No one signs for you.

tax.label: Tax Filing
tax.hint: See what is owed. The assistant can handle the filing.

lease.label: Lease
lease.hint: Compare rent and deposit, then choose whether the space fits.

lease_end.label: Leases
lease_end.hint: Choose where to work next. Check the exit costs before giving notice.
